title: Correct the DEAS v1.0 Generation 2 lifecycle contract
objective: Reconcile the accepted DEAS lifecycle rule, C4 plan, enforcement matrix, and C3 validator so immutable packages remain READY_FOR_EXECUTION with embedded review and Git post-action states PENDING while external records bind review and delivery.

scope.description: Exactly 10 DEAS definition-correction paths on deas/v1-phase2-generation-2, with C3 as the immutable predecessor and C4 retained as a separate unstaged layer.

non_goals: Change or stage a C4 path in the definition-correction commit
Weaken or waive a DEAS gate or create an exception
Adopt DEAS outside the DobeWorks repository
Begin Phase 3, assign a Role Disposition, qualify, or release
Access or change devices, storage, credentials, permissions, private sources, repository settings, collaborators, or unrelated files
Amend, rebase, reset, force-push, delete, or rewrite history
requirements: Preserve C3 commit 47b32aeeb107584291f69ba90b11706c7cf3eae0 and its accepted 13-artifact definition identity.
Keep immutable package tasks READY_FOR_EXECUTION and embedded independent-review and post-action-validation states PENDING.
Bind G7 delivery, G8 review, and G9 acceptance in external control-plane evidence without rewriting reviewed package bytes.
Update the C4 plan, enforcement matrix, and DEAS validator to one lifecycle contract without exception.
Reject a Generation 2 task that embeds COMPLETE, review PASS, or post-action PASS before external delivery.
Verify canonical DEGS engineering-gate SHA-256 44c33ba743851d7befe11ebf93f2f4d9021b126f951a4587562adfca21f65c1e before and after use.
Emit closed-schema machine-readable JSON with a stable rule ID and path for argument and runtime validation errors.
Preserve the exact Generation 1 six-finding negative regression and all existing DEAS profiles, overlays, invariants, resource bounds, and authority exclusions.
Refreeze all 13 active DEAS definition artifacts in the sorted non-self manifest.
acceptance_criteria: The definition-correction diff contains exactly the 10 authorized paths and no C4 path is staged with it.
The public DEAS validator tests pass, including independent rejection of embedded Generation 2 task completion, review PASS, and post-action PASS claims.
The validator rejects an unfrozen engineering gate and emits structured JSON for argument and runtime errors.
Definition validation passes with three profiles, six overlays, ten invariants, matching Generation 1 findings, and a verified artifact manifest.
Direct Generation 1 conformance exits 1 with exactly the frozen six findings.
This task JSON validates and its Tier 1 DEGS evaluation passes while independent review and Git post-action validation remain PENDING.
Syntax, Strict function-size, JSON, links, diff, hash, secret, positive, negative, timeout, exhaustion, and diagnostic checks pass.
External Standards and Spec reviews bind the exact frozen manifest and report no blocker without changing canonical package bytes.
One coherent correction commit is pushed non-force to the existing private branch and draft PR; main remains unchanged and no merge occurs.
assumptions: C3 is 47b32aeeb107584291f69ba90b11706c7cf3eae0 and is the local and remote task-branch head before this correction.
C2 and the immutable Generation 1 baseline remain f45ae80c64a0aa8c723a5a58b4fbc7073682d349.
The separately frozen 15-path C4 working layer remains byte-identical until this correction is delivered.
alternatives: Change the standard to permit embedded COMPLETE before Git delivery
Use duplicate or ambiguous JSON status values to satisfy conflicting checks
Create an exception for the first conforming Generation 2 correction
Commit C4 together with the definition correction
selected_design: Preserve the stronger accepted lifecycle rule, make package PASS explicitly pre-review and pre-delivery, keep embedded review and post-action states PENDING, freeze external executable inputs, emit structured failures, and bind later G7, G8, and G9 evidence externally.

rollback.procedure: Preserve C3, the verified complete-history bundle, the exact pre-correction C4 patch, the correction candidate, review evidence, and owned lock. Do not amend, reset, rebase, force-push, delete, merge, or automatically roll back.

risk_analysis.summary: Tier 1 reversible private-repository policy, validator, test, task, evidence, and manifest correction bounded by exact paths, frozen predecessors, deterministic tests, independent review, and non-force Git delivery.

target_identity: C3 47b32aeeb107584291f69ba90b11706c7cf3eae0 plus exactly the 10 definition-correction paths and the externally bound deas-v1-sha256.txt.
blast_radius: Exactly 10 definition-correction paths on one private task branch and draft pull request; no C4 staging in this commit and no main, merge, release, device, storage, credential, or cross-workspace change.
stop_conditions: A predecessor, branch, path, C4 byte, manifest, private-remote, task-lock, or writer check changes unexpectedly.
Any required check fails and cannot be corrected within the exact 10-path authority, outside the expected Generation 1 nonconformance.
Any exception, unsupported fact, path expansion, authentication interaction, non-fast-forward push, or review finding requiring wider scope becomes necessary.

Any merge, main mutation, root adoption, Phase 3, release, Role Disposition, device, storage, credential, permission, physical, destructive, security-setting, collaborator, or unrelated action would occur.
